generator.materials: run_floor_generator.py:229-241: draw_materials(Random(sha256(repr(pool seeds))[:8])) over the pool's full seed list (D-E03)

shipped.source: D-E05: min-max of the six shipped building YAMLs (notes/01 §E); other fields DEFAULT_RANGES

training_windows.rule: any 30-day window of a training station's CSV starting on a Sunday at 06:00; fold k never uses its held-out station (D-E06, D-E12)

draw.method: random.Random(int.from_bytes(sha256(label)[:8], 'big')).shuffle(range); take candidates in order, skipping seeds whose floor plan fails the official zone-area check (scenario_generator._check_generated_zone_areas); REQ-020: also skipping seeds whose floor plan has control volumes the simulator constructor rejects (one-cell-thick strips)

j7.method: per fold: the 80 buildings shuffled with shipped and default alternating in pairs; iteration i uses buildings 4i..4i+3, each of the 4 training stations once (shuffled) and the 4 presets once (a 4 x 4 Latin square over iterations 4j..4j+3), so every station, every preset and every station-preset pair is equally used in the fold
